name: ch9_fig07_group_split_leakage

Split cards from every container across a green area "훈련" and mauve area "테스트", with a single red crossing arrow and exact label "배경 정보 중복". Panel B marker "B" and title "세포주 그룹 분할". Make clear that group identity, not class color, controls the split. Exact labels only, no full-sentence explanation, caption, logo, watermark, score, or stray text.
